verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented opt-out from AI model training and no no-training commitment. The closest item, an admin switch to disable personal data storage (parahelp-docs-11), is a related data-retention control, not a training opt-out. Adjacent controls earn no credit, and since this axis fairly applies to an AI support SaaS, the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
